title: Template fetch and render engine
description:
apps/server/src/actions/scaffold/render.ts:
- fetchTemplate(url, ref, path, token): shallow clone into a per-step temp dir (reuse the git helper from orgs/git-source.ts; extract a shared lib/git.ts if needed), SSRF guard on the URL, size cap (e.g. 50 MB), timeout.
- renderTree(dir, values, options): walk files, apply include/exclude globs, render file contents and path segments with lib/expr.ts templates ({{ inputs.name }}, {{ entity.* }}, {{ steps.* }}); binary detection (NUL byte in first 8 KB) copies as-is; files > 1 MB copied as-is.
- Never evaluate user-provided input as an expression (same tokenizer rule as the rest of the engine).
- Return the list of rendered files for the step log.
Tests: fixture template with rendered file names, nested dirs, binary file, excluded path, and a failing expression (step fails with a clear message).
close_reason: Exists in scaffolder.ts: API-based template fetch, {{ var }} rendering in paths and text, binaries copied, unknown variables and unsafe paths refused, size caps. Tests in scaffolder.test.ts.
